user.title: Add an OVAPI favourite
user.description: Find a stop by town and name. Then choose the stop sign or direction. OVAPI uses public, unencrypted HTTP; coverage varies. For NS trains, use the separate Nederlandse Spoorwegen integration.

data_description.name: Your label, such as Amsterdam Amstel.
data_description.lines: Blank = all lines. Exact public numbers separated by commas, for example 50, 51. Do not add an M unless OVAPI reports it.
data_description.destination: Blank = all destinations. One text fragment, for example Centraal; not a comma-separated list.
data_description.walking_minutes: Used by the companion cards to calculate when to leave.
data_description.transport_types: All selected by default, including future services. Select at least one transport type. This does not imply every mode serves this stop.

reconfigure.title: Change the favourite
reconfigure.description: Change the stop, label or filters. Connection validation shares the global request budget.

menu_options.search: Find a different stop by name
menu_options.manual: Edit the name or timing-point code (advanced)

data_description.walking_minutes: Walking time for local leave countdowns.

manual.title: Enter a timing-point code
manual.description: Use a known OVAPI code for one stop sign or platform. Leading zeros matter. Extra lookups wait automatically; your entries are kept. Leave line and destination filters blank to follow changing services.

data_description.transport_types: All selected by default, including future services. Select at least one transport type. This does not imply every mode serves this stop.
data_description.lines: Blank = all lines. Exact public numbers separated by commas, for example 50, 51. Do not add an M unless OVAPI reports it.
data_description.destination: Blank = all destinations. One text fragment, for example Centraal; not a comma-separated list.

combined.title: Combine existing favourites
combined.description: Select 2-12 existing favourites for one departure board. Their filters still apply; leave source filters unrestricted to include new services. Combinations cannot contain other combinations. No extra OVAPI requests are made. If any source is missing, disabled, unloaded or expired, the whole board is unavailable. In preferences, saved missing sources appear by ID so you can remove or replace them.

data_description.source_entry_ids: Create at least two single-stop favourites first. Unavailable favourites remain selectable. Names and entity IDs identify your sources.
data_description.walking_minutes: Walking time for this combined board, not inherited from a source.

search.title: Find a stop
search.description: Enter a town and part of the stop name, for example Amsterdam Amstel. Search uses a temporary local directory, not a request for each keystroke.

area.title: Choose a stop
area.description: Choose the town and stop name. Next, available stop signs or directions will load. Codes distinguish identical names.

point.title: Choose your stop sign
point.description: Choose one stop sign or direction. Currently reported in these choices: {observed_modes}. A dash means no current mode information, not no service. Names, lines and destinations are current examples, not complete coverage. An empty departure list does not mean that no services operate.

data_description.name: Your own label for this favourite.
data_description.stop_id: Codes distinguish stop signs where source descriptions are missing.
data_description.lines: Blank = all lines. Exact public numbers separated by commas, for example 50, 51. Do not add an M unless OVAPI reports it.
data_description.destination: Blank = all destinations. One text fragment, for example Centraal; not a comma-separated list.
data_description.walking_minutes: Used by the companion cards to calculate when to leave.
data_description.transport_types: All selected by default, including future services. Select at least one transport type. This does not imply every mode serves this stop.

retry.title: Stop lookup needs attention
retry.description: Retry waits automatically for the shared request budget. You can also search again or enter a known code.

progress.lookup: Checking OVAPI. This continues automatically and keeps your entries; close to cancel.
progress.budget_wait: Waiting for the shared lookup allowance, until at least {resume_at} (Home Assistant time). This is not a limit on the number of favourites. Your entries are kept and setup continues automatically; close to cancel.
progress.server_pause: OVAPI requested a pause or a recent request failed. The next eligible check is at {resume_at} (Home Assistant time), possibly later if another request fails. Your entries are kept; this continues automatically. Close to cancel.

error.reconfigure_in_progress: Another setup window is changing this favourite. Finish there or close it before trying again.
error.short_query: Enter at least two characters, or choose advanced code entry.
error.invalid_sources: Select 2-12 different single-stop OVAPI favourites. Other combinations cannot be selected.
error.already_configured: This combination of source favourites is already configured.
error.invalid_walk: Enter a whole number of walking minutes from 0 to 120.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach OVAPI. The integration will back off; try again later.
error.unknown_stop: OVAPI did not return this stop. Check its timing-point code.
error.invalid_stop: Enter a timing-point code containing 1-10 digits.
error.invalid_data: OVAPI returned invalid or ambiguous data. Try again later.
error.response_too_large: OVAPI returned more data than the safety limit allows. Retry later or use a known code; do not repeatedly reload.
error.unknown_area: OVAPI did not return this stop area. Search again or use a known code.
error.invalid_area: This stop-area identifier is invalid. Search again.
error.no_matches: No matching stop metadata was found. Try a town or shorter name. This is not evidence that there are no services.
error.too_many_matches: Too many stops match. Add a town or more of the stop name.
error.no_points: No usable timing points were returned for this area. Retry later, search again or use a known code. This does not mean there are no services.
error.selection_expired: The temporary stop information expired. Retry to load fresh choices.
error.discovery_busy: Too many stop lookups are open. Close another setup window and retry.
error.rate_limited: OVAPI requested a pause. Submit again to wait automatically until the shared deadline; your entries are kept.
error.too_many_stops: At most ten distinct timing points are supported per Home Assistant instance.
error.invalid_transport: Select at least one transport type: bus, tram or metro.

abort.discovery_busy: Too many stop lookups are open. Close another setup window and try again.

create_entry.default: Your departure feed is ready to connect to a dashboard. The entity shows feed status, not departure times. [Install the OVAPI companion cards in HACS]({card_install_url}), then add an OVAPI card and select this favourite's entity. [Card setup guide]({card_docs_url}).
